fact: The APDP fined Société Aminata Konaté SARL (Bara Mousso) 5 million FCFA under article 65 of Law 2013-015 for refusing a verification mission, and issued a formal notice for failing its declaration formalities; the page text gives no date, which the search return put at 2025-06-19.
title: Sanction pour non-respect des Données Personnelles : Pénalité de 5 millions de FCFA imposée à la Société Aminata Konaté (Bara Mousso)
